pass_rule: PASS only if the frozen companded arm has ratio < 1.0 versus raw persistence on all four NLS tests in all three fresh replicates (12/12 cells).
interpretation: Phase 13 changes only the amount of observed context relative to Phase 12: eight decoded context frames and seven observed transitions are used instead of three frames and two transitions. The tokenizer, compander, 16-feature basis, ridge, wave+Gray-only representation training mixture, NLS generator and evaluation regimes remain frozen. The 12/12 pass supports the Phase-12 diagnosis that short-context transition-estimation noise, rather than representation capacity, caused the unseen-NLS failure. More independent observed transitions reduce coefficient-estimation error enough for robust long-horizon and OOD rollouts on this synthetic NLS family.
claim_limit: This confirms context sufficiency for this fixed representation+identifier on one known synthetic unseen PDE family. It does not establish a universal scientific tokenizer, unrestricted law discovery, novel physics, AGI, or SSI.
